result.summary: 本文提出 Movie Gen，一组媒体生成基础模型，可生成 1080p 高清视频及同步音频，并支持基于指令的视频编辑和基于用户图像的个性化视频生成 [abstract]。其最大视频生成模型为 30B 参数 Transformer，最大上下文长度 73K 视频 token，对应 16 秒、16 FPS 的生成视频 [abstract]。模型在文本到视频合成、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频生成和文本到音频生成等多个任务上取得新的最优结果 [abstract]。作者还公开了两个基准 Movie Gen Video Bench 和 Movie Gen Audio Bench，并详细给出模型架构、训练、推理与实验设置，希望加速媒体生成模型的研究 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的核心科学挑战是让 AI 系统具备生成、组合和预测能力，并以图像、视频、音频作为输出空间，而非 LLM 的文本输出空间 [S1.p1]。作者希望构建一组媒体生成基础模型，能够原生生成高保真图像、视频和音频，并具备编辑和个性化视频的能力 [S1.p1]。作者还指出，公开基准和详细的模型、训练、推理与实验细节有助于加速媒体生成模型研究 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.
While Large Language Models (LLMs) aim to learn such capabilities with a text output space, in this paper we focus on media – image, video, audio – as the output space.
Movie Gen models can natively generate high fidelity images, video, and audio while also possessing the abilities to edit and personalize the videos
We also provide thorough details on model architectures, training, inference, and experimental settings which we hope will accelerate research in media generation models.

method.text: Movie Gen 包含两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频和文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。视频模型在时空压缩的隐空间中进行生成，使用时间自编码器（TAE）将 RGB 图像和视频映射到压缩隐空间，并采用 Flow Matching 训练目标 [S3.p2]。模型骨干紧密遵循 LLaMa3 的 Transformer 设计，并加入交叉注意力、自适应层归一化和全双向注意力 [S3.SS1.SSS3.p3]。作者还通过后训练为视频模型加入个性化（PT2V）和精确编辑（Movie Gen Edit）能力 [S2.p3]。

evidence.quote: Movie Gen Video. A 30B parameter foundation model for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation
Movie Gen Audio. A 13B parameter foundation model for video- and text-to-audio generation
we train a single temporal autoencoder model (TAE) to map both RGB images and videos into a spatio-temporally compressed latent space
We use the Flow Matching training objective to train our generative model.
We build our Transformer backbone by closely following the Transformer block used in the LLaMa3 architecture.
We use full bi-directional attention instead of causal attention used in language modeling.
We add video personalization and video editing capabilities to our foundation Movie Gen Video model via post-training procedures

experiments.text: 作者在文本到视频生成上与 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs、Kling1.5 和 OpenAI Sora 等系统比较，使用 Movie Gen Video Bench 提示集或公开视频提示，并采用人工 A/B 评估 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p1]。作者公开了包含 1003 个提示的 Movie Gen Video Bench，覆盖人类活动、动物、自然风景、物理以及不寻常主体和活动等概念 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1]。音频方面，作者在 VGGSound、OpenAI Sora、Runway Gen3 以及新提出的 Movie Gen Audio Bench 等单镜头视频上评估音效生成，并在多镜头短片上评估音效与音乐联合生成 [S6.SS3.SSS2.p3][S6.SS3.SSS2.p5]。视频编辑方面，作者在 TGVE+ 和新提出的 Movie Gen Edit Bench 上评估，后者包含 64 个验证视频和 128 个测试视频 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: This includes the black-box commercial models that offer API access through their website: Runway Gen3, LumaLabs, Kling1.5.
We also compare to closed source text-to-video methods (OpenAI Sora)
which consists of 1003 prompts that cover all the different testing aspects summarized above
This includes VGGSound, OpenAI Sora, Runway Gen3, and our proposed Movie Gen Audio Bench.
We source 26 short films generated by OpenAI Sora and by Movie Gen Video to create this set.
Overall, the benchmark validation set has 64 videos, whereas the test set has 128 videos.

findings.text: 在文本到视频生成上，Movie Gen Video 在整体质量上显著优于 Runway Gen3（净胜率 35.02%）和 LumaLabs，对 OpenAI Sora 取得中等净胜（8.23%），与 Kling1.5 持平（3.87%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。在真实感和美学上，Movie Gen Video 显著优于 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs 和 Kling1.5，对 OpenAI Sora 在真实感上取得显著净胜（11.62%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p3]。音频方面，Movie Gen Audio 在同步性、正确性和整体质量上大幅优于所有基线 [S6.SS4.SSS1.p3]。视频编辑方面，在 TGVE+ 基准上，人工评估中 Movie Gen Edit 在整体标准上比当前最优 EVE 被偏好 74% 更多 [S5.SS3.SSS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond $2\sigma$.
Our generations moderately net win over OpenAI Sora (8.23%) (net win rate within 1-2 $\sigma$) and are on par with Kling1.5 (3.87%).
Movie Gen Video significantly outperforms Runway Gen3, LumaLabs and Kling1.5 on both metrics, with 48.49%, 61.83% and 37.09% net win rates on realness, respectively.
Compared to OpenAI Sora, Movie Gen Video has a significant win on realness with 11.62% net win rate beyond $2\sigma$

Movie Gen Audio outperforms all baselines on all metrics by a large margin: with 33.8% to 72.8% on synchronization, 27.5% to 82.2% on correctness for all videos, and 31.3% to 91.0% on overall quality for generated videos.
On the TGVE+ benchmark, our model is preferred 74% more often than the current state-of-the-art EVE in the overall Human evaluation criterion.

limitations.text: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理、状态变换等方面仍存在生成或编辑视频的伪影 [S8.p2]。生成音频在运动密集、视觉上较小或被遮挡、或需要更细粒度视觉理解时有时会不同步，且由于设计选择目前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。作者还指出，使用人工评估定义客观标准仍然具有挑战性，人工评估可能受个人偏见、背景等因素影响 [S8.p2]。此外，模型分别针对视频和音频训练，开发能联合生成这些模态的模型是重要的研究方向 [S8.p2]。

evidence.quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
Generated audio is sometimes out of synchronization when motions are dense ( e.g., tap dance), visually small or occluded ( e.g., footsteps), or when it requires finer-grained visual understanding
It currently does not support voice generation either due to our design choices.

defining objective criteria evaluating model generations using human evaluations remains challenging and thus human evaluations can be influenced by a number of other factors such as personal biases, backgrounds etc.
While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.
